g.aria-label: One Window of Length T Trains T Prefix Prediction Tasks Simultaneously
Chain-Rule Factorization: log P(x_(1:T+1)) = ∑_(t=1)^T log P(x_(t+1) | x_(1:t))
Row t of logits Z_t depends ONLY on prefix x_(1:t) because upper-triangular scores are −∞.
At step 0 (random weights), uniform p ≈ 1/V gives initial loss ln(256) ≈ 5.55 nats/byte.
